sourceFile: 2.1 BRS-161014 Report check problem Sub 2 CM+CP 2023.08.02_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it merges separate report contexts and misstates the primary changed factors.
issues: One changed factor combines material shine, press-jig method, bonding amount, and drop-test yoke conditions.
Baseline/test condition is incorrect; MG shiny vs MG not shiny is a primary comparison in sheet 12.9.
Several outcomes omit paired comparator rows, especially MG shiny rows needed for rate comparison.
Sheets 12.9 and 2.8 appear to be distinct validation contexts with different dates/titles.
Drop-test rows are grouped under an unrelated mixed changed factor.
correctionPlan: Split sheet 12.9 and sheet 2.8 into separate review cases unless source proves one unified report.
For sheet 12.9, set primary factor to CMG/MG shiny vs not shiny and keep bonding amount as subgroup.
Include both shiny and not-shiny rows for over-glue and decap outcomes.
For sheet 2.8, separate or clearly model press-jig method and material shine comparisons by metric section.
Treat drop-test yoke bonding-amount rows as separate context or exclude from the main material/press comparison if not comparable.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient for final evidence because grouping and comparator coverage are wrong.
